name: Yoshida (Shizuoka, Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Yoshida town emblem in white: a ring of concentric arcs enclosing a four-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Yoshida, a town in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 September 1972.

features.role: Yoshida town emblem — a ring of concentric arcs enclosing a four-pointed star
